train_model_full: train a PyTorch model for multiple epochs with checkpoint saving and learning rate scheduling
train_one_epoch: train a PyTorch model for one epoch with gradient clipping and tensorboard logging
save_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model checkpoint state dictionary to a .pth file on disk
checkpoint_state: create a checkpoint state dict containing model state, optimizer state, epoch, and iteration
model_state_to_cpu: move all tensors in a PyTorch model state dict from GPU to CPU memory
